answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 43373 Country: Pakistan Title: Jhut n bahana... Question: What is the difference between bahana (useless excuse) and jhut (lie) and what is their status in Islam in accordance to the Quran and sunnah. If a person makes any useless excuse; is there any punishment for him/her in Islam? Answer ID: 43373 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 241/188/B=1434) Fake excuse and lies are almost similar. If someone does so he/she shall be sinful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
